name: Ayase Miki
source:
Grade: Junior high school 3rd grader.
Room: Megae Dorm, Room 101.
Characteristics: Miki is kind and can get along easily with anyone.
She is  a girly girl, she likes baking and cooking. She also loves flowers.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080331225921/http://www.kid-game.co.jp/kid/game/game_galkid/milky/chara.html]official site[/url].]
